relationships.claim: The human pancreas has both exocrine and endocrine functions; its organization includes endocrine islets within a predominantly exocrine organ.

Human pancreatic endocrine tissue, including insulin-secreting beta cells and glucagon-secreting alpha cells, shows disease-associated changes in type 1 and type 2 diabetes; these changes are heterogeneous and should not be generalized to an individual patient.

sources.title: Organisation of the human pancreas in health and in diabetes.
sources.evidenceRole: Review of human pancreatic anatomy, dual exocrine/endocrine function, islet cell biology, and pancreas changes in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
